topics.name: Queen and king against king
topics.about: The queen pushes their king to the edge; your king comes up to help give mate.

topics.name: Rook and king against king
topics.about: The rook cuts their king off; your king faces theirs; the rook checks from the side.

topics.name: The two-rook ladder
topics.about: Two rooks take turns checking, a rank at a time, until their king is on the edge.

topics.name: The square of the pawn
topics.about: Can the king catch a running pawn? Count the square from the pawn to its queening rank.

topics.name: King and pawn: the opposition
topics.about: Kings facing each other with one square between: the side that does not have to move holds the key squares.

topics.name: Rook endings: Lucena and Philidor
topics.about: The two positions every rook ending comes back to: how to win the first, how to hold the second.

positions.name: From the middle of the board
positions.idea: Use your queen to box their king in, a knight's move away from it, then bring your king up to help.

positions.name: Their king in the corner
positions.idea: Their king has almost no squares left. Before every queen move, make sure their king still has a move unless you are giving check.

positions.name: The kings far apart
positions.idea: The queen alone cannot mate: shrink their king's box with the queen, then walk your king across.

positions.name: From the middle of the board
positions.idea: Cut their king off with the rook, bring your king opposite theirs, and check from the side when they face each other.

positions.name: Kings facing each other
positions.idea: The kings face each other: a rook check from the side now leaves their king no square.

positions.name: The ladder
positions.idea: One rook checks, the other guards the next rank; keep them apart from their king so it cannot take them.

positions.name: Their king near the edge
positions.idea: Push their king back a rank at a time with the two rooks; your king can stay at home.

positions.name: Catch the pawn
positions.idea: Step into the pawn's square: from the pawn to its queening square and across as many files. Inside it, your king catches the pawn.

positions.name: Run with the pawn
positions.idea: Their king is outside the pawn's square: push the pawn at once and it cannot be caught.

positions.name: The king in front of the pawn
positions.idea: Keep your king in front of the pawn and use a pawn move to make them give way.

positions.name: Hold with the opposition
positions.idea: Face their king with one square between: then their king must give way, and yours stays in front of the pawn.

positions.name: Lucena: build a bridge
positions.idea: Check their king away from the pawn, then bring your rook to the fourth rank to shield your king from the checks.

positions.name: Philidor: the third-rank defence
positions.idea: Keep your rook on the sixth rank, your third, until the pawn moves up; then go to the back of the board and check from behind.
